fields.description: Issue includes local political and civic commentary and reporting on Miami municipal affairs, including allegations of bolita gambling operations and discussion of policing and city court activity. It also covers tourism and entertainment/nightlife listings and advertisements, sports and racing news (including Gulfstream Park and the Orange Bowl), and national-policy commentary on federal spending, public debt, and the welfare state. Additional features include a health-related item on tobacco and mortality and business/community notes.
